scope: User-confirmed development route: Qwen3.5 2B text and image-capable architecture plus separate CPU OCR. Not app-bundled or release-qualified; 2B image execution still pending.

runtime.tested_platform: Linux x86_64 AVX2/FMA/F16C, shared two-core quota; Windows/macOS/ARM not yet validated

prompt_baseline.description: Tune short gentle/playful companion prompts for chosen 2B. GUI personality still pending; historical Qwen2.5 prompt no longer selected.
prompt_baseline.release_validation: Pending: renaming/identity, multi-turn unknown observations and GUI personality variations.
prompt_baseline.latency_note: 2B fifth-round uncached shared two-core Linux: first content p50/p95 5.13/13.65s; total 20.22/35.71s. Not 8GB 11th-gen i5 benchmark; no 2B image latency measurement.

capabilities.image_capability_note: Model architecture supports images only with matching projector and runtime; 2B projector not downloaded/executed yet. This flag describes capability, not tested app support.

observation_plan.ocr_trial: RapidOCR v3.10.0 + ONNX Runtime CPU, explicit PP-OCRv5 mobile detection/Chinese recognition. v6 tiny smaller comparison; not yet executed or final OCR selection.
observation_plan.vision: Selected 2B matching 671372416-byte BF16 projector; 2B image test pending. Include matching visual component in planned AI package; do not load it for ordinary text requests.
observation_plan.routing: OCR first for screen text; 2B images only for user requests or image-dominant observations, no concurrent heavy inference by default.

release_blockers: Host-owned preference source/write and real execution states; companion naming continuity assessed as experience, not a zero-error chatbot gate
Companion response length/tone and multi-turn experience; observation scope/source enforced by host
Native Windows/macOS/ARM and game-concurrent CPU/RAM tests
Actual per-platform installation size, licenses, runtime distribution and cancellation/idle unload
SQLite, chat UI, GUI personality and 30-day retention integration

selection_policy.tolerated: Low-risk factual slips and playful imagined dog actions; not automatic rejection.
host_owned_boundaries: long-term preference source and actual writes

target_hardware.cpu: Intel Core i5 11th generation; exact SKU pending native benchmark
target_hardware.status: user selected target, not tested device
target_hardware.threads: benchmark 2 and 4 workers; leave responsiveness headroom, do not assume double speed
